query:
SELECT EXISTS (
                SELECT 1
                FROM factory_step s
                JOIN factory_run r ON r.id = s.run_id
                WHERE s.run_id = $1 AND s.seq = $2
                    AND s.session_id IS NOT NULL
                    AND s.session_released_at IS NULL
                    AND s.ended_at IS NULL
                    AND r.ended_at IS NULL
            ) AS "holds!"
